items.summary: The heavy hardcore army grows stronger every day. The latest band to join the chugging, grunting horde is Scorched Earth Policy, an Upstate New York crew with a lineup that includes members of bands like Missing Link and Laid 2 Rest. items.summary: Thank You , the first solo work from Mike D, ascribed to the appellation Mike D 5D. Though he hasn’t been too far from music, producing records for Portugal. The Man and Soft Play, the album follows a long period of creative grief. But the work of his sons Davis and Skyler Diamond and their circle of friends have drawn the wildest Beastie back to writing and performing once again. The post Mike D :: Thank You first appeared on Aquarium Drunkard .

items.title: Crying Laughing :: Talking
items.summary: Strange and turbulent times call for insistent new theme songs and rallying cries. On Talking , Baltimore’s Crying Laughing answer the call with necessary and emphatic instrumental anthems, driven by a twin alto sax attack and percussion that channels the snap and bounce of New Orleans rhythms. The result feels tightly interlocked, yet constantly in motion. The post Crying Laughing :: Talking first appeared on Aquarium Drunkard .
